parts.instructions: Listen to the phone call and choose the best answer A, B, C or D (Questions L1–L5).
parts.context: Nadia, who works in the marketing team, phones Ivan at IT support about the company's new web browser.

script.speaker: Ivan
script.text: IT support, Ivan speaking. How can I help?

script.speaker: Nadia
script.text: Hi Ivan, it's Nadia from the marketing team. I'm using the new browser today, and I'm having a few problems.

script.speaker: Nadia
script.text: Well, I'm looking at the company news page, but it's showing yesterday's news. I know there's a new article this morning.

script.speaker: Ivan
script.text: Right. Do you see the round arrow at the top left, next to the address bar? That's the refresh button. Click on it.

script.speaker: Nadia
script.text: OK... Yes, the new article is there now. The other problem is the text. It's very small, and I can't read it easily.

script.speaker: Ivan
script.text: No problem. Hold down the Control key and press the plus key. The text gets bigger every time you press it.

script.speaker: Nadia
script.text: That's much better. And one more thing. Every time I open the browser, it starts with a search page. I want it to start with our company intranet.

script.speaker: Ivan
script.text: Then you need to change the home page. Click on the three dots in the top right-hand corner and choose Settings. You'll see a section called On start-up. Type the intranet address there.

script.speaker: Nadia
script.text: Great, I understand. I'm doing it now... Done!

script.speaker: Nadia
script.text: No, that's everything. Thanks a lot!

questions.stem: Why is Nadia phoning IT support?

options.text: She is having problems with the new browser.
She cannot log in to the intranet.

questions.explanation: Nadia nói "I'm using the new browser today, and I'm having a few problems."

questions.stem: What is wrong with the company news page?

options.text: It is in the wrong language.

questions.explanation: "it's showing yesterday's news". Ivan bảo bấm nút refresh để trang hiện bài mới.

questions.stem: How can Nadia make the text bigger?

options.text: Hold Control and press the plus key

questions.explanation: "Hold down the Control key and press the plus key. The text gets bigger every time you press it."

questions.stem: What does Nadia want the browser to show when it starts?
questions.explanation: "I want it to start with our company intranet." Trang tìm kiếm là trang trình duyệt đang mở mỗi lần khởi động.

questions.stem: Where does Ivan tell Nadia to type the intranet address?

options.text: In an email to IT support

questions.explanation: Ivan nói vào Settings, tìm mục "On start-up" rồi "Type the intranet address there".

parts.instructions: Listen to the talk and answer the questions. Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS for each answer (Questions L6–L10).
parts.context: Martin, a customer service manager, explains the company's email guidelines to new staff.

script.speaker: Martin
script.text: Good morning, everyone. As new staff, you'll write a lot of emails to customers, so here are our company's email guidelines.

script.speaker: Martin
script.text: First, the subject line. Keep it short, no more than eight words, and make it clear. Second, only send an email to the people who really need it. If someone only needs to know about something, put them in copy, but please don't copy the whole department.

script.speaker: Martin
script.text: Third, every email must end with the company signature, which includes your name, your job title and your phone number. You'll find the signature in the settings. Please don't change the colours or add pictures to it. Fourth, always use the spell checker before you press Send. Customers notice mistakes, and a message with mistakes looks careless.

script.speaker: Martin
script.text: Finally, we reply to customer emails within one day. If you need more time to find an answer, send a short reply that says when you'll write again. And one last thing: never share a customer's personal information by email. Are there any questions?

questions.stem: What is the maximum number of words in a subject line?
questions.explanation: "Keep it short, no more than eight words".

questions.stem: Where can staff find the company signature?
questions.explanation: "You'll find the signature in the settings."

questions.stem: What must staff use before they press Send?
questions.explanation: "always use the spell checker before you press Send".

questions.stem: How quickly does the company reply to customer emails?
questions.explanation: "we reply to customer emails within one day".

questions.stem: What must staff never share by email?
questions.explanation: "never share a customer's personal information by email".

matching.instructions: Match the terms (1–5) with the correct definitions (A–F). There is one extra definition that you do not need (Questions 1–5).

definitions.text: A small device that plugs into a computer and works as an electronic key to unlock access to a piece of software.
A document or file that is sent with an email message.
Software that recognises letters and numbers written on paper, so that paper documents can be scanned into a computer.
A system that connects computers to each other over a large area, sometimes between countries.
A way of saving the address of a web page so that you can find it again.
A device that measures how quickly the speed of an object increases.

items.explanation: Bookmark (dấu trang) là cách lưu địa chỉ trang web để tìm lại sau.
Attachment (tệp đính kèm) là tài liệu hoặc tệp được gửi kèm thư điện tử.
Dongle là thiết bị nhỏ cắm vào máy tính, hoạt động như chìa khoá điện tử để mở quyền dùng phần mềm.
Accelerometer (cảm biến gia tốc) đo tốc độ tăng của vận tốc một vật, ví dụ khi điện thoại bị xoay hay di chuyển.
WAN (Wide Area Network, mạng diện rộng) nối máy tính trên một khu vực rộng, có khi giữa các quốc gia. Định nghĩa C là của OCR (nhận dạng ký tự quang học), không có trong danh sách thuật ngữ.

grammar.stem: Please wait a few minutes. I ______ the new browser at the moment.
grammar.explanation: "at the moment" chỉ việc đang diễn ra nên dùng hiện tại tiếp diễn: "am installing".

grammar.stem: I ______ what this error message means. Can you help me?
grammar.explanation: "understand" là động từ chỉ trạng thái nên dùng hiện tại đơn, không dùng tiếp diễn. Chủ ngữ "I" đi với "don't" + động từ nguyên mẫu; các phương án còn lại sai ngữ pháp.

grammar.stem: The technician ______ looks after our servers is on holiday this week.
grammar.explanation: Mệnh đề quan hệ chỉ người (the technician) dùng "who" (hoặc that). "which" dùng cho vật.

grammar.stem: A browser is a program ______ shows web pages on your screen.
grammar.explanation: Mệnh đề quan hệ chỉ vật (a program) dùng "which" (hoặc that).

grammar.stem: If you click the refresh button, the page ______ any new information.
grammar.explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 0 (điều luôn đúng): If + hiện tại đơn, hiện tại đơn: "the page shows".

grammar.stem: If we buy tablets for the sales team, they ______ able to work on the train.
grammar.explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 1 (kết quả có thể xảy ra): If + hiện tại đơn (buy), will + V: "will be able to".

grammar.stem: My laptop battery lasts only ______ hour, so I always carry my charger.
grammar.explanation: "hour" bắt đầu bằng âm nguyên âm (h câm) nên dùng mạo từ "an": "an hour".

vocabulary.stem: Chrome and Firefox are examples of a web ______.
vocabulary.explanation: Web browser (trình duyệt web) là chương trình tìm và hiển thị thông tin trên Internet.

vocabulary.stem: Check the email address of the ______ before you click Send.
vocabulary.explanation: Recipient (người nhận) là người nhận thư; cần kiểm tra địa chỉ người nhận trước khi gửi.

vocabulary.stem: A ______ uses shapes and lines to show the stages of a process.
vocabulary.explanation: Flowchart (lưu đồ) là hình vẽ dùng các hình và đường nối để thể hiện các bước của một quy trình.

vocabulary.stem: Click the ______ button to return to the page that you were looking at before.
vocabulary.explanation: Back button (nút quay lại) đưa bạn về trang trước đó. Nút refresh làm mới trang đang xem.

vocabulary.stem: The delivery app uses ______ to show the driver's exact position.
vocabulary.explanation: GPS (hệ thống định vị toàn cầu) dùng tín hiệu vệ tinh để chỉ vị trí chính xác.

vocabulary.stem: This tablet has a long ______ life, so you can use it all day without charging it.
vocabulary.explanation: Battery life (thời lượng pin) là khoảng thời gian pin còn dùng được.

vocabulary.stem: A ______ network uses radio signals instead of cables.
vocabulary.explanation: Wireless (không dây) là kết nối bằng sóng vô tuyến thay cho dây. Wired là có dây.

vocabulary.stem: Online banking websites ______ your card details so that nobody else can read them.
vocabulary.explanation: Encrypt (mã hoá) là chuyển thông tin thành mã đặc biệt mà chỉ một số người đọc được.

passage.title: Tablets for Home-Care Nurses
paragraphs: Carewell is a home-care company in Leeds. Its thirty nurses visit elderly patients in their homes every day. Until last year, the nurses carried paper records for each patient. They wrote notes by hand and took the papers back to the office at the end of the day, where an assistant typed everything into the computer system. The nurses also had to phone the office if they needed information about a new patient. This took a lot of time, and sometimes the papers were lost.

Now each nurse has a tablet with a special app. If a doctor changes a patient's medicine, the nurse sees the new information immediately, because the app updates the records over the mobile phone network. The tablets also have GPS, so the app shows each nurse the quickest route to the next patient.

At the end of each visit, the patient or a family member signs the screen with a finger. The app then sends an electronic version of the visit report to the office. The assistant no longer needs to type anything and now spends most of the day organising the nurses' timetables.

There is one problem. The tablets use a lot of power, and the battery life is only about six hours. If a nurse works a long shift, the tablet sometimes switches off before the last visit. The company is now putting a car charger in every nurse's car. Each charger costs about twenty pounds.

questions.stem: What was one problem with the paper records?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 1: việc này tốn thời gian "and sometimes the papers were lost".

questions.stem: How does GPS help the nurses?

options.text: It shows the quickest route to the next patient.
It sends visit reports to the office.
It makes the battery last longer.

questions.explanation: Đoạn 2: nhờ GPS, ứng dụng "shows each nurse the quickest route to the next patient".

questions.stem: What happens at the end of each visit?

options.text: The patient or a relative signs the screen.
The nurse prints a paper record.

questions.explanation: Đoạn 3: "the patient or a family member signs the screen with a finger". Trợ lý không còn phải gõ báo cáo.

questions.stem: What does the office assistant mainly do now?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 3: trợ lý "now spends most of the day organising the nurses' timetables".

questions.stem: What is the company doing about the battery problem?

options.text: Buying new tablets with bigger batteries
Putting a charger in every nurse's car
Switching off the GPS on the tablets

questions.explanation: Đoạn 4: "The company is now putting a car charger in every nurse's car."

passage.title: The Network at Hillside College
paragraphs: Hillside College has about 1,200 students and 300 computers. The computers in the three computer labs are connected to the network with cables, because students often download large files and a wired connection is faster and more reliable.

In the library and the cafeteria, students use the wi-fi, which is free for everyone who has a college account. Visitors can use a separate guest network, but it is slower, and it does not give access to the college server.

The server, which is in a locked room next to the IT office, stores all the students' work, and it is backed up every night. Students who forget to save their work on the server can lose it, because the lab computers delete all local files when they restart.

The network is managed by two technicians who work from Monday to Friday. At the weekend, there is no technical support, so the college asks students to report any problems by email. A technician reads these emails first thing on Monday morning.

questions.statement: The computers in the labs use a wired connection.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 1: máy trong phòng lab "are connected to the network with cables" (kết nối có dây).

questions.statement: Students have to pay to use the wi-fi in the library.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2: wi-fi "is free for everyone who has a college account".

questions.statement: Visitors on the guest network can access the college server.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2: mạng cho khách "does not give access to the college server".

questions.statement: The lab computers keep local files after they restart.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 3: máy trong lab "delete all local files when they restart".

questions.statement: Students should report problems by email at the weekend.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 4: cuối tuần không có hỗ trợ kỹ thuật nên trường đề nghị sinh viên "report any problems by email".

network for staff: Bridge-Staff / password from reception
network for visitors: Bridge-Guest / no access to the company server
the old network / stop working on Friday
staff who work from home: use the VPN / it encrypts company data

targetGrammar: Present continuous for things happening now (at least once): The IT team is installing…
Relative clauses (at least one): which, that, who
Zero conditional (If + present simple, present simple) or first conditional (If + present simple, will + verb), at least one
email.modelAnswer:
Dear Sara,

Here is some information about our new wireless network. This week, the IT team is installing it in every office. Staff should connect to Bridge-Staff and ask reception for the password. Visitors can use Bridge-Guest, which has no access to the company server. The old network will stop working on Friday, so if people try to use it after that, it won't work. Staff who work from home should use the VPN, which encrypts our data. If a device can't connect, please call the helpdesk on extension 210.

Best regards,
Tom

parts.instructions: Explain network concepts. Speak for 1–1.5 minutes.
parts.prompt: A new student at your college does not understand some network words. Explain what each word in the cues means and give an example from your college or home. Use relative clauses with which, that or who (A server is a computer which…).
requiredGrammar: Relative clauses with which or that for things: A LAN is a network which…
Relative clauses with who or that for people: A network technician is a person who…
parts.sampleAnswer: Let me explain these words. A server is a computer which provides services to other computers on a network. For example, our college has a server that stores all the students' work. Wi-fi is a way of connecting devices to a network which uses radio signals instead of cables. I use the wi-fi in the library every day. A LAN is a network that connects computers inside one building or organisation, like the computers in our labs. A VPN is a secure network which lets people outside the office use the company's network through the internet. My father uses one when he works from home. Finally, a network technician is a person who looks after the network and fixes it when there is a problem.

parts.instructions: Deal with the situation. Speak for 1–1.5 minutes.
parts.prompt: You work at a small hotel. Your manager is not sure whether to give the maintenance and cleaning staff smartphones with a work app. Explain the benefits and one possible problem. Use first conditional sentences (If we give…, staff will…) and at least one zero conditional sentence (If a room is…, the app…).
cues: the app shows which rooms need cleaning / no need to phone reception
staff take a photo of a broken item / maintenance team sees it immediately
possible problem: phones get lost or broken / buy strong cases
requiredGrammar: First conditional: If + present simple, will + verb
Zero conditional: If + present simple, present simple
parts.sampleAnswer: I think smartphones with a work app are a good idea. If we give the cleaning staff smartphones, they will see which rooms need cleaning, so they won't need to phone reception every time. The app is very simple: if a guest checks out, the room appears on the list automatically. If the maintenance staff have phones, they will also work faster. For example, if a cleaner finds a broken lamp, they will take a photo, and the maintenance team will see it immediately. That means guests will get faster repairs and they will be happier. There is one possible problem. If staff drop the phones, they will break. So if we buy the phones, I think we should also buy strong cases for them.
